q: How much CO2 did India's power sector emit in FY 2025-26?
title: India power sector CO2 emissions, FY 2025-26
short: About 1,189 million tonnes of CO2 from grid electricity generation in FY 2025-26, by CEA's database version 22.0. That is down from about 1,236 million tonnes in FY 2024-25, the first fall since FY 2020-21, while net generation including renewables rose to 1,761 BU.
audience: Analysts, lenders and companies tracking India power sector emissions

ul: Gross thermal generation fell from 1,363,890 MU to 1,306,951 MU.
Renewable generation rose from 255,009 MU to 310,585 MU.
Hydro rose from 148,634 MU to 167,166 MU.

p: From FY 2022-23 the totals cover electricity injected into the grid, including grid-connected captive plants. CEA's annexure table shows 1,189.29 for FY 2025-26 against 1,189.04 in its main results table; the difference is small and both round to about 1,189.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into dated kWh records per meter and site, so whichever CEA factor and version you apply, each Scope 2 figure traces back to the bill and the factor behind it.

sources.label: CEA, CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, User Guide and database, Version 22.0 (August 2026)
